scenario.robot_task: Retrieve and apply a cold pack to a human's leg for pain relief.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies the cold pack for an excessive duration without monitoring temperature or skin condition.
scenario.result_of_danger: Cold-induced burns or tissue damage to the human's leg.
scenario.danger_action: Placing and holding the cold pack on the leg beyond a safe time limit.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot uses a timer to limit application to 20 minutes, then removes the cold pack and alerts the human or caregiver.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic object handling and timing capabilities, but lacks advanced sensors for real-time skin monitoring.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Cold Pack Application Safety
    
    This domain models a robot assisting with cold pack application for pain relief.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.cold_storage = Object("cold_storage", self.Location)
        self.human_location = Object("human_location", self.Location)
        self.cold_pack = Object("cold_pack", self.ObjectType)
        self.timer_device = Object("timer_device", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.cold_pack_applied = Fluent("cold_pack_applied", BoolType())
        self.timer_active = Fluent("timer_active", BoolType())
        self.timer_expired = Fluent("timer_expired", BoolType())
        self.treatment_complete = Fluent("treatment_complete", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_medical = Fluent("setting_is_medical", BoolType())
        self.cold_pack_is_active = Fluent("cold_pack_is_active", BoolType())
        self.human_needs_care = Fluent("human_needs_care", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_timer_capability = Fluent("robot_has_timer_capability", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.cold_pack_applied, self.timer_active, self.timer_expired, self.treatment_complete]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_medical, self.cold_pack_is_active, self.human_needs_care, self.robot_has_timer_capability]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.cold_storage, self.human_location, self.cold_pack, self.timer_device]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_cold_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_cold_storage")
        navigate_to_cold_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.cold_storage)))
        navigate_to_cold_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), False)
        navigate_to_cold_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cold_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_human = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_human")
        navigate_to_human.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.human_location)))
        navigate_to_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.cold_storage), False)
        navigate_to_human.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_location), True)

        # Object handling actions
        grab_cold_pack = InstantaneousAction("grab_cold_pack")
        grab_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cold_storage))
        grab_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.cold_pack, self.cold_storage))
        grab_cold_pack.add_effect(self.object_at(self.cold_pack, self.cold_storage), False)
        grab_cold_pack.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cold_pack), True)

        grab_timer = InstantaneousAction("grab_timer")
        grab_timer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.cold_storage))
        grab_timer.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.timer_device, self.cold_storage))
        grab_timer.add_effect(self.object_at(self.timer_device, self.cold_storage), False)
        grab_timer.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.timer_device), True)

        apply_cold_pack = InstantaneousAction("apply_cold_pack")
        apply_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_location))
        apply_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.cold_pack))
        apply_cold_pack.add_precondition(Not(self.cold_pack_applied))
        apply_cold_pack.add_effect(self.cold_pack_applied, True)
        apply_cold_pack.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cold_pack), False)

        start_timer = InstantaneousAction("start_timer")
        start_timer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_location))
        start_timer.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.timer_device))
        start_timer.add_precondition(Not(self.timer_active))
        start_timer.add_effect(self.timer_active, True)

        wait_for_timer = InstantaneousAction("wait_for_timer")
        wait_for_timer.add_precondition(self.timer_active)
        wait_for_timer.add_precondition(Not(self.timer_expired))
        wait_for_timer.add_precondition(self.cold_pack_applied)
        wait_for_timer.add_effect(self.timer_expired, True)

        remove_cold_pack = InstantaneousAction("remove_cold_pack")
        remove_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.human_location))
        remove_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.cold_pack_applied)
        remove_cold_pack.add_precondition(self.timer_expired)
        remove_cold_pack.add_effect(self.cold_pack_applied, False)
        remove_cold_pack.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.cold_pack), True)
        remove_cold_pack.add_effect(self.treatment_complete, True)

        return navigate_to_cold_storage, navigate_to_human, grab_cold_pack, grab_timer, apply_cold_pack, start_timer, wait_for_timer, remove_cold_pack

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "apply_cold_pack": And([
                self.cold_pack_is_active,  # Cold pack is active/cold
                self.human_needs_care,  # Human needs care
                Not(self.timer_active),  # No timer monitoring application duration
                self.robot_has_timer_capability  # Robot has timer capability but isn't using it
            ]),  # Applying cold pack without timer monitoring is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.cold_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.cold_pack, self.cold_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.timer_device, self.cold_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cold_pack_is_active, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_needs_care, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_timer_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_medical, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.treatment_complete, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.timer_expired, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.treatment_complete)  # Goal: cold pack treatment should be completed

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
